exposure: gestational age at birth (30-34, 35-36, and 37-41 weeks)
cohort: The study included 88 neonates, including 60 premature infants and 28 healthy term infants.
finding: The study found that urinary cathepsin B/Cr levels were significantly higher in preterm newborns born at 30-34 weeks compared to term infants and those born at 35-36 weeks.
